old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-dvku","title":"Gateway slot APIs allow invalid dimensions and ordinals to panic or exhaust CPU","description":"P2 security review finding. The newly exported rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs exposes unchecked coordination/config dimensions. SuperframeConfig has public duration_s and slots_per_superframe fields; superframe_id()/current_slot() divide or modulo by them and panic when either is zero. The free timestamp helpers have the same divide/modulo-by-zero behavior. SlotAllocator::allocate_for_ordinal() documents ordinal \u003c gateway_count but never enforces it; contiguous allocation loops 0..ordinal and performs unchecked u32 additions/range endpoints, so an untrusted very large ordinal can cause CPU exhaustion or overflow/panic. validate_interleaved_pattern likewise performs unchecked u32 multiplication/addition. Replace panicking constructors/raw public fields with validated fallible construction or explicit Result errors, reject zero dimensions and ordinal \u003e= gateway_count, use checked arithmetic, and add hostile boundary tests.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:26:06.665377Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:26:06.665377Z"}
